_readme.about: Tradetron strategy export. Edit and re-import via the ASB Import button.
_readme.logic: To change a condition's logic, edit its "conditionJson" (the AST). The "conditionValue"/"conditionDisplay" text is regenerated from it on import.
_readme.legs: For a leg field that has a "*Json" (e.g. "strikeJson"), edit the JSON — its text form is regenerated on import. Fields with no "*Json" (e.g. "qty") are plain text: edit them directly.
_readme.structure: Add/remove/duplicate legs, conditions or sets by editing the arrays.
_readme.do_not: Do not add "*_id" foreign keys back. Lists referenced by id must be ones you own.

name: OTM4 3Min Momentum Strategy v2
description:
Nifty 50 OTM4 Momentum Intraday Strategy (Fully Parameterized)

Strategy Notes:

---------------

1. Entry:

  • Time: Between 9:20 AM and 3:00 PM.
  • Selection: Continuously monitors OTM4 (ATM +/- OTM_Offset) Call and Put options on a 3-minute timeframe.
  • Condition: Enters long if the previous 3-min candle closed `Jump_1` higher than the one before it, and the current 3-min candle closed `Jump_2` higher than the previous one, backed by a `Spot_Confirm` underlying movement.

2. Exit:

  • Target: `Target_Multiplier` (e.g., 3.0x Entry Price).
  • Stop Loss: `SL_Multiplier` (e.g., 0.8x Entry Price).
  • Universal Exit: Square off all positions intraday at 3:15 PM.
